$comment: Every input that changes the artifact, and the hash they produce.
IMPORTANT: the hash is only meaningful for the canonical environment below.
Cargo embeds a metadata hash derived from the build path into generated-code
paths inside the artifact, so the same source at a different path yields a
different hash — measured, see REPRODUCIBILITY.md. The canonical environment
fixes the path, which is what makes the hash checkable at all.
Update this file in the same commit that changes any pinned input.

canonicalEnvironment.how: docker build --platform linux/amd64 -f Dockerfile.reproduce -t signal-bridge-repro . && docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 signal-bridge-repro
canonicalEnvironment.why: Fixed path and fixed CARGO_HOME remove the two machine-dependent inputs that survive path remapping.

measurements.note: differs from canonical by build-metadata identifiers only, not by compiled logic
same machine as path A — proves the build path itself is an input
